stories.title: AI job loss forecasts loom as unions push for protections
stories.simple_summary: As AI gets better at doing jobs, unions are asking the government to make rules that protect workers from losing their jobs.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have employees, this might eventually affect labor laws and worker protections — but nothing urgent right now.

stories.title: Breakingviews - COMMENTARY: China's AI dragons breathe fire on Nvidia's moat
stories.simple_summary: China is developing its own AI companies that are competing with Nvidia, an American chip company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: US and China eye Trump-Xi talks on AI guardrails despite tech rift
stories.simple_summary: The US and China are talking about making rules together for AI technology, even though they're in competition on other tech issues.
stories.why_it_matters: This is politics between countries — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
stories.simple_summary: Two newspapers (Seattle Times and Newsday) are suing OpenAI and Microsoft because they say these companies used their news articles to train AI without asking permission.
stories.why_it_matters: If you create original content (writing, photos, videos), this shows that AI companies might use your work without paying you — something to keep an eye on.

stories.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
stories.simple_summary: Authors are arguing that publishers are trying to claim too much money from a settlement about AI training.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a writer or create content, these legal battles might eventually affect whether AI companies have to pay you — but it's still very early.

stories.title: Education experts discuss decision to ban AI in New York City public schools for at least this year
stories.simple_summary: New York City schools are not allowing AI tools in classrooms for now, and experts are discussing whether this is the right choice.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids in NYC schools or are concerned about education, this means your children won't use AI tools in class this year.

stories.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
stories.simple_summary: A tech founder who started Uber is working on a company that might build self-driving taxi cars.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and the car industry — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
stories.simple_summary: AI companies are releasing new versions of their AI tools so quickly that people are getting tired of keeping up.
stories.why_it_matters: The fast pace of change might feel overwhelming, but you don't have to use every new version — stick with what works for you.

stories.title: I’m a father of three who studies the impact of artificial intelligence: this is what parents need to know about AI
stories.simple_summary: A researcher who is also a parent is sharing what parents should know about AI and how it might affect their children.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a parent or grandparent, this is worth reading to understand how AI might show up in your kids' lives.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence answers: what is the expected result of the London derby?
stories.simple_summary: An AI tool predicted the winner of a London sports match.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't matter to most people — it's just for sports fans who want to see if AI can guess game results.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
stories.simple_summary: Two newspapers (Seattle Times and Newsday) are suing OpenAI and Microsoft because they say their news articles were used to train AI without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: If you create original content, this shows that AI companies might use your work without paying you — something to keep an eye on.

stories.title: Broadcom vs. Nvidia: 1 Critical Metric Shows Which Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chipmaker Is the Better Buy After Earnings
stories.simple_summary: An investment article is comparing two computer chip companies (Broadcom and Nvidia) to help investors decide which is the better investment.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in tech stocks — nothing you need to act on.
